newsitem.title: CAYMAN ISLANDS: Caymans Island Stock Exchange has no listings yet.
newsitem.headline: Caymans Island Stock Exchange has no listings yet.

text.p: Caymans Islands government officials said Wednesday the Cayman Islands Stock Exchange's opening remained on hold while they worked to find mutual funds to list on the exchange.
The exchange had been expected to open on April 1, 1997, but no listings had been secured, said Assistant Finance Minister Debbie Drummond.
Drummond told the government Finance Committee that listing agents had been certified and were familiarizing themselves with their responsibility as agents.

She also said computers and equipment were in place at the exchange for the start of trading and things were "working according to plan." She said US$250,000 had been collected as fees from the listing agents.
Drummond did not give a date for the start of trading.
The Cayman Islands Stock Exchange will initially trade in mutual funds and other special purpose financial vehicles. The Finance Ministry has said stocks and bonds will eventually be added.
